member.name: T:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles
member.summary: Canonical role-claim string constants for the Safety domain (PlantSafety and its Reporting sibling). All [Authorize(Roles = ...)] / RequireRole(...) usages across PlantSafety.Api and Reporting.Api should reference these constants instead of inline string literals, to prevent role-name drift across modules.

member.name: F:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles.Viewer
member.summary: Read-only access to Safety-domain data. Lowest tier.

member.name: F:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles.Editor
member.summary: Create/update access to Safety-domain records (standard write operations).

member.name: F:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles.Approver
member.summary: Elevated write access for state-transition operations that carry safety or regulatory weight: approve, close, escalate, dispatch, resolve, reject, cancel.

member.name: F:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles.PlatformAdmin
member.summary: Full administrative override. Canonical spelling of the role previously inconsistently written "Platform.Admin" (AuthorizationPolicyExtensions.cs) vs "PlatformAdministrator" (ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs). This constant's value ("Platform.Admin") was chosen because it is the spelling already used by the majority (~140) of per-module policy registrations; the minority usage ("PlatformAdministrator") has been updated to match.

member.name: F:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles.ViewerAndAbove

member.name: F:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles.EditorAndAbove
member.summary: Editor and every tier above it. Use for standard create/update (POST/PUT) endpoints.

member.name: F:Shared.Authorization.Abstractions.Roles.SafetyRoles.ApproverAndAbove
member.summary: Approver and every tier above it. Use for approve/close/escalate/dispatch/resolve endpoints.
